bio: Situated in the heart of Knightsbridge, the Franklin London is a stylish boutique hotel tucked away on Egerton Gardens.  The Haute Couture Afternoon Tea is an ode to fashion, to creative designers, to inspiring style and to iconic elegance. The ultimate experience for fashion enthusiasts, tea lovers and sophisticated hoarders of elegance.  Get ready to indulge in the figs mousse & orange sable Sheath Dress, walk the catwalk with a yoghurt and lemon cake Pochette or touch up your lips with our red chocolate lipstick.  The Franklin London is an intimate space to enjoy the menu and is a 7-minute walk from South Kensington Tube Station.
